jobs.description: Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale. The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement scalable architectures for APIs serving millions of advertisers at thousands of transactions per second - Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) server infrastructure—an emerging standard for AI agent-data interaction—that delivers advertiser context with sub-second latency and minimal token consumption - Establish system design patterns and best practices for global ads experience at scale

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the PE & Growth Investor Partnerships at ElevenLabs, you will build and scale one of our most strategic growth channels. You will own relationships with leading PE & Growth Investor firms, embed ElevenLabs into their Enterprise Value Creation programs, and drive AI adoption across portfolio companies.

Operating at the intersection of PE, Growth Investors, enterprise AI, & GTM, you will partner with Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, portfolio executives, and our Sales organization to source, accelerate, and close opportunities. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of BD & Partnerships & all regional GTM leads to define the strategy while owning execution across multiple PE & Growth Investor relationships.

Your success will be measured by your ability to build a scalable investor partner ecosystem that consistently generates enterprise pipeline and ARR.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 6 - 9 months, you will:

- Launch the ElevenLabs Private Equity & Growth Investor Partner Program.

- Recruit and activate 8–10 leading PE and growth investor partners, securing ElevenLabs’ inclusion in their Value Creation and portfolio engagement programs.

- Build a repeatable GTM engagement model between investor operating teams and ElevenLabs to accelerate portfolio company adoption, pipeline generation, and deal velocity.

- Establish a foundation for a scalable, partner-sourced ARR business.

RESPONSIBILITIES

PRIVATE EQUITY & GROWTH INVESTOR PARTNERSHIPS

- Build and manage executive relationships with Operating Partners, Value Creation leaders, and investment professionals across leading PE & Growth investor firms.

- Structure and negotiate partnership agreements, joint GTM plans, referral models, and enterprise value programs.

- Become the trusted AI partner for PE firms looking to accelerate value creation across their portfolio.

PORTFOLIO COMPANY ACTIVATION

- Identify high-priority portfolio companies and develop joint account plans with PE operating teams.

- Coordinate with Enterprise AEs, FDEs, Customer Success, and Product to drive AI deployments from initial introduction through production.

- Help portfolio companies identify high-value AI use cases and accelerate adoption.

PIPELINE & REVENUE

- Own pipeline generation and ARR sourced through PE partnerships.

- Build and maintain a rolling portfolio company pipeline across assigned sponsors.

- Drive executive introductions, accelerate deal velocity, and expand successful deployments across additional portfolio companies.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

- Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to execute PE opportunities.

- Develop repeatable GTM playbooks, executive engagement models, and portfolio-wide AI adoption frameworks.

- Represent ElevenLabs at PE conferences, operating partner forums, and executive events.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 8–12+ years of experience in Enterprise AI, Cloud, or enterprise software, with a focus on strategic partnerships involving Private Equity and Growth Investors.

- Have experience working with PE firms, Growth Investors, Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, or PE-backed portfolio companies.

- Have a track record of building strategic partnerships that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.

- Have strong executive presence and can engage credibly with Managing Partners, Operating Partners, CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, and investment professionals.

- Have successfully navigated complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

- Are comfortable discussing AI platforms and enterprise technology with both business and technical audiences.

- Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy building new partnership motions from the ground up.

- Are highly commercial, operate with urgency, and consistently create opportunities where none previously existed.

LOCATION

This role is remote-first but NYC or London is preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Are you passionate about technology, engineering and operational excellence? Would you like to help Amazon customers meet their daily needs? If you answered yes, Amazon’s Worldwide Grocery Stores Tech (WWGST) organization is looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) like you.

At WWGST, we are solving a fundamental need for customers - food and nutrition. We serve millions of customers around the planet by making it easier to solve their grocery needs through multiple offerings that meet them where needed. Whether it’s online or in-person, multiple brands, or supporting omni-channel shopping missions, we want Amazon to be the go-to relationship.

In this role, you will drive key engineering initiatives for the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team including the development and execution of excellence goals, operational planning, security fortification and technical readiness. Each of these areas are critical to ensure we can reliably serve our customers while continuing to innovate on our portfolio of solutions. You will work across the WWGST organization in partnership with tech teams and leadership to ensure we can deliver on this promise.

This is a unique opportunity for someone interested in working in an entrepreneurial environment to drive deliverables with visibility and impact. The successful candidate will possess a strong program management background, have demonstrated experience leading large programs, and have a well-rounded technical background.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will be responsible for delivering programs with medium complexity and/or those that have broad cross-organizational, global, or technology impact. Your work will focus on large product, process and engineering efforts that solve complex problems. You will be trusted to operate with complete independence and are often assigned to focus on areas where the business and/or technical strategy has not yet been defined.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive high priority, complex projects across many teams.
- Work with business owners to define requirements.
- Collaborate with tech teams on technical design.
- Own the program execution and delivery process, including how to deliver iteratively, early and often.
- Help resolve blockers to program delivery.
- Proactively identify and mitigate project risks by anticipating challenges and taking ownership of outcomes.
- Effectively partner with all levels of leadership.

- Influence organizational priorities, system owners, business, and technology direction.
- Manage cross-functional communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs aligned.
- Recognize when current programs are susceptible to prior failure patterns and actively steer leadership to avoid repeating these failures.
- Know when a design or solution requires additional technical guidance and seek their input.
- Show excellent judgment in driving executive-level escalations.
- Deliver solutions that meet Amazon high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.
- Amplify your impact by educating the TPM and engineering communities (within your organization as well as more broadly) on program management best practices.
- Participate, sharing knowledge and collaborating with other TPMs, specifically attending and/or presenting at internal conferences.

WWGST's IAM Operational Excellence team's objective is to unify identity and security and integrate that unity into data, applications, & technology building blocks. We deliver an architecture that supports seamless authentication, fine-grained authorization and adaptive access control supporting modern, legacy applications and data consumption requirements. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Data Infrastructure designs, operates, and scales secure, privacy-respecting systems that power data-driven decisions across Anthropic. Our mission is to provide data processing, storage, and access that are trusted, fast, and easy to use.

We're looking for infrastructure engineers who thrive working at the intersection of data systems, security, and scalability. You'll tackle diverse challenges ranging from building financial reporting pipelines to architecting access control systems to ensuring cloud storage reliability. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders while diving deep into cloud infrastructure primitives.

Responsibilities:

Within Data Infra, you may be matched to critical business areas including:

•

Data Governance & Access Control: Design and implement robust access control systems ensuring only authorized users can access sensitive data. Build infrastructure for permission management, audit logging, and compliance requirements. Work on IAM policies, ACLs, and security controls that scale across thousands of users and systems.

•

Financial Data Infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and warehouses powering business-critical reporting. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and availability for complex financial systems, including third party revenue ingestion pipelines; manage the external relationships as needed to drive upstream dependencies. Own the reliability of systems processing revenue, usage, and business metrics.

•

Cloud Storage & Reliability: Architect disaster recovery, backup, and replication systems for petabyte-scale data. Ensure high availability and durability of data stored in cloud object storage (GCS, S3). Build systems that protect against data loss and enable rapid recovery.

•

Data Platform & Tooling: Scale data processing infrastructure using technologies like BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, dbt, and Spark. Optimize query performance, manage costs, and enable self-service analytics across the organization.

You might be a good fit if you:

• Have 10+ years (not including internships or co-ops) of experience in a Software Engineer role, building data infrastructure, storage systems, or related distributed systems
• Have 3+ years (not including internships or co-ops) of experience leading large scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead
• Can set technical direction for a team, not just execute within it
• Have deep experience with at least one of:
• Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python, Go, Java, or similar
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS)
• Can navigate complex technical tradeoffs between performance, cost, security, and maintainability
• Have excellent collaboration skills - you work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience with security and compliance requirements (ITGC, GDPR, financial controls)
• Background in data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, or analytics infrastructure
• Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native architectures
• Track record of improving data reliability, availability, or cost efficiency at scale
• Knowledge of column-oriented databases, OLAP systems, or big data processing frameworks
• Experience working in fintech, financial services, or highly regulated environments
• Security engineering background with focus on data protection and access controls

Technologies We Use:

• Data: BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, Cloud Composer, dbt, Spark, Segment, Fivetran
• Storage: GCS, S3
• Infrastructure: Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS
• Languages: Python, Go, SQL

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

The mission of our Retention Marketing team is to build lasting relationships with our audiences – consumers, dashers, and/or merchants – as soon as they engage with DoorDash by providing them with a personalized, cross-channel experience that delights them and drives them to return to DoorDash to find the products and experiences that are relevant to them.

About the Role

As the Retention Marketing Lead for DashPass, you will define and evolve the membership marketing vision, translating subscriber growth and retention goals into CRM strategies and leading a team responsible for delivering high-quality, data-driven campaigns across email, push, SMS, promotions, and in-app messaging. You will collaborate with all parts of the business, ensuring cohesive strategy, clear prioritization, and measurable business impact on membership growth and retention. In this role, you will sit on the Consumer Retention Marketing team with a key objective of driving incremental GOV and Paid Net Adds.

You will report into the Head of Consumer Retention Marketing on our Growth Marketing team within our Marketing organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Oversee all owned channel marketing campaigns and programs across the DashPass lifecycle, ensuring a cohesive, personalized journey
• Lead the development of annual and quarterly Retention marketing plans, maximizing incremental gains to meet overarching audience-level business targets
• Manage a team of Retention Marketers, providing structure and coaching for the team to deliver against retention and engagement goals
• Oversee the testing roadmap for CRM campaigns including message/content strategy, target audience segmentation, and measurement plans
• Identify and develop means for improving personalization and relevance across the DashPass lifecycle and partner with Analytics on developing associate measurement frameworks
• Partner with cross-functional leaders (Analytics, Product, Integrated Marketing, Strategy & Operations) to identify strategic initiatives that drive operational scale and efficiency
• Use data to define KPIs and goals across different segments, identify trends, and optimize marketing programs and deliver upon overall company goals
• Partner with MarTech, Product, and Operations to continually advance CRM infrastructure, inclusive of evaluating and optimizing technical platforms and tooling, developing and actioning on new customer models, and optimizing campaign measurement practices.

We’re excited about you because you have…

• 8+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, and/or growth marketing; with 3+ years managing high-performing teams, managing managers experience a plus
• Record of driving business results via cross-channel marketing campaigns
• Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
• Hands-on experience with CRM technology including ESPs, segmentation tools, and complex data structures and systems
• Working knowledge of data tools (e.g., SQL, Databricks, Sigma) and AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to drive analysis, experimentation, and productivity
• Extreme organization, dependability, self-motivation & ability to multi-task
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. Position Summary Serves as the operational inventory management and distribution coordination expert within Global Clinical Supply Chain. Responsible for maintaining global inventory visibility, ensuring supply readiness, and coordinating global clinical supply distribution activities to support uninterrupted delivery of investigational product (IP) to patients. Through close partnership with Clinical Supply Leads (CSLs), Trial Supply Managers (TSMs), Logistics, depots, and external partners, the Inventory Planning Coordinator (IPC) drives effective inventory management, identifies and mitigates supply risks, and enables efficient operational execution across the clinical supply chain to support clinical trial success. Duties/Responsibilities Works cross-functionally as part of a dynamic matrix team to plan delivery of clinical drug supply to ensure sufficient supply availability for new and ongoing studies. For drug supply planning, the TSM initiates the planned depot transfers, based on product-specific demand required for the established time period(s). The Inventory Planning Coordinator utilizes this information to coordinate and follow up on depot shipments to ensure sufficient supplies are at the local depots in accordance with the MRB (Must Reach By) date. Leads operational coordination between Logistics, Shipment Execution, Warehouses, and Depot providers to ensure timely execution of approved inventory movements Inventory planning management includes responsibility for monitoring expiry dates and ensuring replacement supply is available at the local depots as well as proactively identifying and communicating upcoming inventory concerns/risks to responsible TSM. Owns operational tracking and prioritization of QP (Qualified Person) release activities utilizing key milestone dates provided by the TSM. Ensures country/study approval of product for assigned programs/studies as part of depot planning. Supports execution and tracking of approved manual allocations and inventory movements. Maintains visibility of approved inventory movement plans and escalates execution risks or delays affecting implementation. Communicates changes to the Shipment Execution Team. Advises TSM of drug supply constraints and recommends alternative strategies to influence the ability of CSC to meet existing or anticipated demands. Coordinates deployment of approved Use Date Extensions at depots and maintains completion tracking, escalating deployment risks as necessary. If applicable, for program level supplies, prepares Product Information Listings and Batch Listing extract files as required for study database locks and regulatory filings. Participates on key task forces and acts as a change lead for improvement initiatives and procedural updates. Seeks continuous improvement, recommends and implements ways to improve the efficiency of clinical supply chain processes. Serves as the operational owner for inventory execution, distribution coordination and depot readiness activities. Escalates issues requiring supply strategy, forecasting, allocation or study-level supply decisions to the responsible TSM and/or CSL. Acts as a change agent and operational subject matter expert, contributing to process improvements, system enhancements, and initiatives that advance clinical supply chain capabilities and operational excellence. Reporting Relationship Senior Director or Director, Clinical Supply Team Lead Qualifications Minimum 2 years’ experience in Supply chain or Pharma industry. Minimum 1 year Clinical Development with global experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute. Moderate knowledge of the global drug development process and global regulatory requirements with respect to investigational new drugs. Strong analytical and cross-functional negotiation skills. Strong project management skills and handling multiple projects simultaneously. Strong knowledge of Inventory planning and management, and Supply Chain Functionality. Moderate knowledge of import / export requirements. Strong knowledge of industry technology. Oral and written communication skills (fosters open communication). Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration skills. Takes initiative and displays a strong sense of urgency. Education/Experience/ Licenses/Certifications: BA/BS in Science, IT or Business, preferably with focus on IT / Digitization / Supply Chain. ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

TEAM

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

You will join a new Live Studio focused on Helix Jump, one of Voodoo’s most iconic hypercasual hits.

Our ambition is to give Helix Jump a second life: preserve what made it successful, improve the quality and game feel, and evolve it into a stronger hybrid-casual / casual live game.

You will be part of a small, lean, and ambitious team with high ownership and fast iteration.

ROLE

As a Product Manager, you will be at the heart of the game's evolution. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, artists, and product experts to design, test, and refine features that keep our players engaged and entertained.

- Participate in the design and creation of engaging, challenging, and fun levels that maintain player interest and progression

- Develop and iterate on game mechanics and features that enhance the core gameplay loop

- Analyze player behavior, game metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement

- Collaborate with engineers and artists to bring level designs and features to life

- Structure, run, and monitor A/B tests to validate design decisions and optimize player experience

- Balance game difficulty curves to ensure appropriate challenge and retention across all levels

- Stay up-to-date with the hybrid-casual and puzzle game market, analyzing competitor games and emerging trends

- Test and playtest levels and features to ensure quality and enjoyment

- Contribute to the product roadmap and strategic direction

- Work iteratively, rapidly prototyping ideas and incorporating feedback from the team and data

PROFILE

- 2+ years of professional experience in game design, product specialist, or similar role in the mobile gaming industry

- Strong passion for mobile puzzle and hybrid-casual games, with a deep understanding of what makes them engaging and successful

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven design decisions

- Understanding of player psychology and what drives engagement, retention, and satisfaction

- Strong communication skills and ability to clearly articulate design ideas to cross-functional teams

- Iterative mindset with the ability to rapidly test, learn, and improve designs based on feedback

- Bonus: Experience with Unity or game development tools, knowledge of A/B testing methodologies, experience shipping successful mobile games

BENEFITS

- Best-in-class compensation

- Other benefits according to the country you reside

jobs.description: At Amazon, we are always looking for highly passionate, driven, and customer-obsessed leaders who thrive in fast-paced environments and love tackling complex challenges. Our Operations Managers are the backbone of Amazon Logistics (AMZL), ensuring that every package moves efficiently through our network and reaches our customers on time, every time. This isn’t just an operations role—it’s an opportunity to lead, innovate, and make a real impact on the way we deliver smiles to millions of customers. If you are someone who loves problem-solving, driving continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is the role for you! As an OM, you’ll be directly responsible for supervising a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports meanwhile, you will report to the Site Lead of your Delivery Station. jobs.description: Amazon Access is Amazon's co-branded credit card program in Mexico, operated in partnership with Invex, one of Mexico's leading financial institutions. We are building the financial product that enables millions of Mexican customers to access credit, shop on Amazon, and engage with a rewards ecosystem - all within a highly regulated fintech environment. We are looking for a Program Manager III to own and drive critical workstreams across regulatory influence, payment performance, financial modeling, customer analytics, and operational automation. This role sits at the intersection of product, finance, data, and external partner management, requiring someone who can translate complex data into actionable strategy, influence partners and regulators without formal authority, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will work directly with Amazon, Invex, payment processors (PROSA), and external partners (Mastercard) to solve high-impact problems end-to-end. SQL proficiency and data analytics are foundational requirements - you will build analytical frameworks, write queries, design dashboards, and use data to drive every decision. Key job responsibilities Own end-to-end program delivery across payment performance, customer acquisition, engagement analytics, and operational automation workstreams for Amazon Access Mexico. Build and maintain analytical frameworks using SQL, QuickSight, and GenAI tools to diagnose business problems, quantify impact, and inform strategy - including cohort segmentation, funnel analysis, and customer persona targeting. Influence external partners (Invex, PROSA, Mastercard) and regulators (CNBV) via evidence-based analysis and persistent engagement to drive outcomes without formal authority. Design financial models, unit economics frameworks, and attribution methodologies to evaluate program sustainability and inform funding decisions. Identify and execute automation opportunities that eliminate manual operational burden across Finance, Accounting, Product, and FinOps teams. Monitor and recover key payment metrics (PSR, ASR, Share of Wallet) via root cause analysis, transaction-level diagnostics, and cross-company coordination. Translate complex data into stakeholder-compelling narratives for senior leadership, supporting WBR/MBR/QBR cycles and strategic planning (OP1/OP2). Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Finance, BI, and external partners to deliver against the Amazon Access roadmap. A day in the life In this role, you shape the financial product that brings credit access to millions of customers in Mexico. One morning you build the evidence case that convinces a banking regulator to change policy - the next, you diagnose a payment authorization anomaly across three companies and drive the fix before it impacts customers. You design the financial architecture behind a rewards program, model its unit economics, and present the go/no-go recommendation to leadership. You write SQL to uncover why acquisition spiked during a High Value Event, then turn that insight into the strategy for the next one. No two days look the same because you own the full spectrum - from regulatory influence and partner negotiation to data analysis and automation design. This is a role where analytical rigor directly translates into business impact at scale, and where you operate with the autonomy of a founder inside one of the world's most customer-obsessed companies. About the team Amazon Access Mexico is Amazon's co-branded credit card program, built in partnership with Invex. Our mission is to expand financial access for Mexican customers via a product that combines credit, e-commerce, and rewards. We operate in a complex, regulated fintech environment that requires deep collaboration with banking partners, payment processors, and regulators. Our team is small, high-impact, and data-driven — every team member owns significant workstreams end-to-end. We value analytical rigor, Ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across organizational boundaries.

jobs.description: Meet the Team The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. We design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Cisco Silicon One (#CiscoSiliconOne) is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches all the way through web scale data centers and across service provider, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by designing, developing and testing some of the most complex ASICs being developed in the industry. Your Impact As an ASIC Core DFT Technical Lead, you will drive the definition, architecture, and implementation of cutting-edge Design-for-Test strategies across Cisco’s groundbreaking Silicon One portfolio. You will lead cross-functional integration from early-stage design through post-silicon validation, establishing scalable test logic, reusable code, and robust verification methodologies.
